description: This file defines the IPowerManager interface in the WPEFramework project, including enums, structs, and method signatures for power management functionalities such as power states, wakeup sources, notifications, and control methods.

classes.name: IPowerManager
classes.description: Interface for managing power states, wakeup sources, notifications, and control operations in the device.

classes.name: IModePreChangeNotification
classes.description: Notification interface for pre-change power mode events.

classes.name: IModeChangedNotification
classes.description: Notification interface for power mode change events.

classes.name: IDeepSleepTimeoutNotification
classes.description: Notification interface for deep sleep timeout events.

classes.name: INetworkStandbyModeChangedNotification
classes.description: Notification interface for network standby mode changes.

classes.name: IThermalModeChangedNotification
classes.description: Notification interface for thermal mode changes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Register a notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregister a notification callback.

methods.name: AddPowerModePreChangeClient
methods.description: Register a client for power mode pre-change engagement.

methods.name: RemovePowerModePreChangeClient
methods.description: Disengage a client from power mode pre-change operations.

methods.name: SetPowerState
methods.description: Set the device's power state.

methods.name: GetPowerState
methods.description: Retrieve the current and previous power states.

methods.name: GetThermalState
methods.description: Get the current thermal temperature.

methods.name: SetTemperatureThresholds
methods.description: Set temperature thresholds for thermal management.

methods.name: GetTemperatureThresholds
methods.description: Get current temperature thresholds.

methods.name: SetOvertempGraceInterval
methods.description: Set the grace interval for temperature overlimit.

methods.name: GetOvertempGraceInterval
methods.description: Get the current overtemp grace interval.

methods.name: SetDeepSleepTimer
methods.description: Configure deep sleep timeout.

methods.name: GetLastWakeupReason
methods.description: Retrieve the reason for last wakeup.

methods.name: GetLastWakeupKeyCode
methods.description: Retrieve the key code used for last wakeup.

methods.name: Reboot
methods.description: Reboot the device.

methods.name: SetNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Set network standby mode.

methods.name: GetNetworkStandbyMode
methods.description: Get current network standby mode.

methods.name: SetWakeupSourceConfig
methods.description: Configure wakeup sources.

methods.name: GetWakeupSourceConfig
methods.description: Retrieve wakeup source configuration.

methods.name: GetPowerStateBeforeReboot
methods.description: Get power state prior to reboot.

methods.name: PowerModePreChangeComplete
methods.description: Indicate completion of pre-change activities for a client.

methods.name: DelayPowerModeChangeBy
methods.description: Delay power mode change for a client.
